description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hirikuluwa, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510203
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, extents, owner names and identities, and land classification details. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
